chunks: Rifa'ah ibn Musa narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

Al-Husayn عليه السلام set out for 'umrah, having driven along a sacrificial camel. When he reached al-Suqya, he was afflicted with illness, so he shaved his head and slaughtered it there in its place. Then he came onward until he arrived and knocked at the door, and 'Ali عليه السلام said, 'My son, by the Lord of the Ka'bah, open for him.' They had heated water for him, and he bent over it and drank, then afterward he performed 'umrah.

key_terms.بَدَنَةً: a sacrificial camel brought for offering

ai.seo_question: What happened when Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام became ill on the way to 'umrah?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts an incident in which Imam al-Husayn عليه السلام set out for 'umrah with a sacrificial animal but was struck by illness on the way. It reflects rulings related to one who is prevented or afflicted during pilgrimage rites, while also preserving a family moment involving Imam 'Ali عليه السلام.
